scenes.text: If gravity switched off right now, you would not float away.
scenes.art_prompt: a person standing calmly in a field as dust lifts off the ground, soft light

scenes.text: You would fall upward with the whole planet's spin behind you.
scenes.art_prompt: motion-blurred view of a horizon tilting as everything lifts, cinematic

scenes.text: Oceans, air, and buildings would leave at the same speed you did.
scenes.art_prompt: water and debris lifting from a coastline into the sky, dramatic 3d render

scenes.text: Earth's own pressure and spin would keep a thin skin of us near the ground.
scenes.art_prompt: a curved planet seen from above with everything peeling away, cosmic scale

scenes.text:
Then the atmosphere would freeze and boil at once as the pressure vanished.
Without gravity, the air that keeps us warm and breathing would not stay for even one breath.
scenes.art_prompt: a silent blue planet with its atmosphere streaming away into space, 3d render

scenes.text: Follow What If Physics for the next question.
scenes.art_prompt: a calm starfield above a quiet horizon, wonder, quiet and final
